title: New-Owner Enrollment Allowance — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
**Allowance.** A replacement purchase of a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans retail plan earns a new-owner enrollment allowance according to how soon after delivery the plan is signed. The span is counted in calendar days, from the delivery date on the deal of the vehicle being covered (the customer's single Kessler vehicle purchase deal standing in delivered status, in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records) to the pricing date, the day the plan is signed.

| Calendar days from delivery to pricing date | New-owner enrollment allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | 30.00 |
| More than 30, up to and including 90 | 15.00 |
| More than 90 | None |

| Hypothetical span | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 days (signed on the delivery date) | 30.00 |
| 30 days | 30.00 |
| 31 days | 15.00 |
| 90 days | 15.00 |
| 91 days | none |
